description: Start an asynchronous crawl of a website. Returns a job_id — poll get_crawl_result to retrieve records. Workspace maximum: 100 pages and depth 5. Reserves the page limit; charges 1 credit per successful page.

browser.description: Browser that renders the crawled pages. Omit to use the default Chrome browser. Set to "kitesurf" to use the Kitesurf browser engine. Requires render to be true.

depth.description: How many links deep to crawl

limit.description: Maximum number of pages to crawl

render.description: Whether to render pages with a browser (vs. fetching raw HTML)

name: start_crawl
